degraded_scan_quality.summary: The WebSearch backend ignores OR/AND operators, returns a handful of unrelated archive/aggregator pages for long OR-chains, and often covers only a few of the 10-12 named entities per batch (the tool itself says it trimmed or simplified queries for many batches). Absence of a result for an entity inside a batch therefore means 'not surfaced', not 'confirmed clean'. Country, city and state batches in particular returned almost no entity-specific October items; T1 city and company searches mostly returned archive pages. Date filtering is by the words 'October 2026' only.

stats.window_note: Caller-specified window 2026-10-08..2026-10-22. validate-scan.mjs derives its window as scan date minus 14 days at 23:59:59Z, so evidence dated 2026-10-08 reads as out of window; two such boundary items are in sector_alerts.
stats.date_conventions: evidence_date is the date of the underlying event or statement where a source states it; some sources are republished one to two days later (validator WARNs on those cases are expected). Per the spec, events older than 7 days at scan time are scored inside the 14-day moderate band (max 20); events inside 7 days up to 40.
stats.tiering_note: T1 = top 150 by base_priority (staleness + importance + volatility + pending-proposal per spec; Universities weighted 5; ties broken alphabetically by slug; pending-proposal flag = proposal status beginning 'pending'; volatility includes pending-proposal 5 as in the spec; no sector systemic-transition bonus). Evidence-found entities are scored news_score + base_priority (capped at 100). Entities flagged via T2/T3 retain tier T2.
stats.batch_size_note: 101 sector-coherent batches of 12 (the final per-index batch of each index is smaller), chunked within each index; 2 more batches than the 99 minimum because batches do not cross indexes.

stats.overage_explanation: T2 used 119 calls for 101 batches (18 re-issues after tool errors plus 1 double run); T3 used 21 sweeps (6 above the 15 floor, within the 15-25 band); 16 verification searches were run (6 above the 10 allowance) because many candidates arrived from undated aggregator pages and needed dated corroboration; 1 combined T1 precursor query was run; per-index batching produced 101 batches instead of 99.
